headline: Federasi Futsal Indonesia Schedules Extraordinary Congress For Dec
seoTitle: Federasi Futsal Indonesia Schedules Congress For December
metaDescription: The Federasi Futsal Indonesia plans an extraordinary congress for December 11, 2026, amid ongoing disputes with PSSI and internal organizational conflicts.
aiSummaryBullets: The Federasi Futsal Indonesia has scheduled its extraordinary congress for December 11, 2026, pending final approval from PSSI.
PSSI officials stated they received 48 requests for the congress and defended the appointment of Vivin Cahyani as a necessary administrative action.
Internal tensions persist, including reports filed with the PSSI Ethics Committee by some FFI members regarding allegations of illegal internal decrees.
aiContextParagraph: The Federasi Futsal Indonesia (FFI) has officially set December 11, 2026, as the date for an upcoming extraordinary congress. This decision follows significant internal pressure, with PSSI reporting receipt of 48 formal requests for the meeting. The involvement of PSSI in FFI affairs has become a subject of scrutiny, particularly regarding the appointment of Vivin Cahyani to lead the proceedings after five executive committee members resigned. While some regional futsal associations have called for greater respect for FFI’s statutes, PSSI secretary-general Yunus Nusi maintained that the organization holds no preferred candidates for the upcoming leadership election, noting that individuals such as Michael Sianipar remain eligible to run. Tensions remain high as some FFI members have filed formal complaints with the PSSI Ethics Committee against PSSI leadership, alleging the issuance of unauthorized or illegal internal decrees regarding the federation's governance.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to coverage by four independent outlets and a high velocity of reporting following recent administrative clashes within the sports federation.
